title: Linear-axion DC conductivity
summary: A finite-frequency master-field reproduction of the four-dimensional DC conductivity in the homogeneous bottom-up Einstein-Maxwell model with two linear massless-scalar sources.

source.title: A simple holographic model of momentum relaxation

conventions.name: bulk theory and units
conventions.value: Four bulk dimensions, AdS radius L = 1, metric signature (-,+,+,+), 16 pi G = 1, Lambda = -3
conventions.rationale: Matches the source action and the d = 3 specialization used for the exact DC target.

conventions.name: radial scale
conventions.value: Source coordinate r with horizon r0 = 1 and UV boundary r -> infinity
conventions.rationale: Uses scaling symmetry while retaining mu/r0, alpha/r0, and omega/r0 as dimensionless inputs.

conventions.name: background sources and ensemble
conventions.value: Grand canonical with nonzero chemical-potential source mu and nonzero scalar-source gradient alpha
conventions.rationale: The background is homogeneous but not source free; the scalar sources explicitly break translations.

conventions.name: fluctuation sources
conventions.value: Unit gauge perturbation a_x^(0) = 1 and zero gauge-invariant scalar/metric source omega chi_0 - i alpha^2 H_tx^(0)
conventions.rationale: The invariant obstruction vanishes, after which one residual boundary diffeomorphism sets the individual scalar and metric sources to zero.

conventions.name: retarded response
conventions.value: Fields have time dependence exp(-i omega t) and use the ingoing horizon branch
conventions.rationale: Fixes the sign of the retarded conductivity and the Frobenius exponent.

parameters.name: horizon scale
parameters.description: Fixed by scaling symmetry in every numerical solve.

parameters.name: frequency sequence
parameters.description: Preregistered finite-frequency sequence used for the DC extrapolation.

parameters.name: horizon cutoff
parameters.description: Numerical regulator for the ingoing Frobenius initialization; halved in the refinement test.

equations.description: Exact charged linear-axion black-brane background with r0 = 1.

equations.expression: r^2 (f Phi_pm')' + [r^2 omega^2/f - mu^2/r^2 + c_pm mu/r] Phi_pm = 0
equations.description: Two decoupled gauge-invariant complex master equations.
equations.source_ref: Source Eqs. (3.24)-(3.26), specialized to d = 3 and zero momentum.

equations.expression: phi = r(c_plus Phi_plus + c_minus Phi_minus), a_x = -i(Phi_plus + Phi_minus)
equations.description: Reconstruction of the coupled gauge/scalar fluctuation variables.
Finite-frequency radial balance identity whose DC limit is conserved.

observables.name: complex electric conductivity
observables.extraction: Fit a_x = a_x^(0) + J_x/r + ... and evaluate J_x/[i omega a_x^(0)].

observables.name: DC electric conductivity
observables.extraction: Extrapolate Re sigma linearly in omega^2 and compare with independent radial-flux intercepts and the exact target 1 + mu^2/alpha^2.

acceptance_criteria: The exact horizon, temperature identity, and Maxwell radial flux satisfy gates 1-3.
The ingoing initialization improves under horizon-cutoff refinement and the UV source-map residuals are below 1e-8 with condition number below 1e10.
The reconstructed source equations and finite-frequency flux balance have normalized residuals below 1e-6.
The radial DC intercepts agree within 5e-3 relative spread and each boundary DC value agrees with 1 + mu^2/alpha^2 within 5e-3 relative error.
The imaginary intercept, frequency-fit stability, horizon refinement, UV refinement, and integrator-tolerance refinement pass the frozen gates.

tests.expected: Background identities, source conditions, reconstructed equations, and flux balance pass their declared residual gates.
All three finite-frequency DC extrapolations reproduce the exact source-model values within 5e-3 relative error.
Horizon-cutoff, UV-endpoint, and integrator-tolerance refinements remain within their frozen limits.

claims.statement: For four bulk dimensions, the source model has exact DC conductivity sigma_DC = 1 + mu^2/alpha^2 at fixed nonzero chemical-potential and scalar-gradient sources.
The HoloForge finite-frequency master-field implementation reproduces all three frozen DC conductivities within the declared thirteen-gate contract.
claims.evidence: Automated source-map, reconstruction, flux, DC-extrapolation, and refinement checks in tests/test_linear_axion_dc.py.

limitations: This is a classical bottom-up effective model and no top-down string embedding is claimed.
The nonzero scalar sources explicitly break translations; the UV problem is not source free.
The neutral mu = 0, translation-invariant alpha = 0, and extremal limits are excluded from the verifier.
The frozen low-frequency sequence tests the DC limit but is not a full optical-conductivity spectrum.
Agreement verifies the implementation of the selected source model; it is not empirical validation of a material or a microscopic momentum-relaxation mechanism.
